title: How each harness loads DD, and which OpenCode hooks can carry text
body: Claude Code and Grok Build install plugins from a marketplace that auto-discovers skills/ (Grok mirrors Claude Code's layout almost exactly); Codex has no marketplace or npm pull, so `deltadictum install --host codex` writes its config. OpenCode has no hook shaped like PreToolUse: tool.execute.before outputs {args} only and session events return void. Text reaches its model two ways: experimental.chat.system.transform (once per turn; it rewrites the system prompt and breaks the prompt cache) and the output of tool.execute.after ({title, output, metadata}), which DD uses to append the memories that fired to the tool's own result; that output carries no exit status, so outcomes cannot be read there. Why: verified 2026-09-19 against @opencode-ai/plugin@1.18.31's type definitions and a real plugin's compiled source, after a first version written from a documentation summary got the signatures wrong.
not_derivable: The adapter shows the hook it uses, not the hooks tried and ruled out, nor that the published docs described them wrongly.

evidence.summary: The header cites the plugin version and the real plugin read before the shim.
How DD reaches the agent on OpenCode, moved from docs/integrations/opencode.md on 2026-10-21.
